questions.question: When should you reduce your speed?
questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: You must reduce your speed when it is not safe to drive at the speed limit. Slow down in snow, ice, rain, or fog.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A crossroad is ahead. Watch for other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: A crossroad is ahead. Watch for other traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a crossroad is coming up ahead.

questions.question: True or false: You should not cross railroad tracks if your entire vehicle will not fit on the other side.
questions.correctAnswerText: True
questions.explanation: Never cross railroad tracks unless your entire vehicle can fit completely on the other side. Do not stop on railroad tracks. Wait until your vehicle has enough space to clear the tracks.

questions.question: What is the best way to reduce your risk of injury or death in a traffic crash?

options.text: Stay in the right lane on highways with multiple lanes.
Drive only between 3:00 p.m. and 6:00 p.m.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wear your seat belt.
questions.explanation: Wearing your seat belt is the single best thing you can do to protect yourself from death or injury in a crash.

questions.question: Which substances can impair your driving and lead to a DUII arrest?
questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above
questions.explanation: Many substances can impair your driving. These include alcohol, illegal drugs, inhalants, and many legal medicines (prescription and over-the-counter).

questions.question: What should you do if an aggressive driver cuts you off?

options.text: Stay calm and move out of their way.
Flash your lights to show the driver they are wrong.
Do something aggressive back to them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay calm and move out of their way.
questions.explanation: Stay calm and get out of the way of an aggressive driver. Do not try to get even with them. This will only make the situation more dangerous.

questions.question: What must a driver show when stopped by police for a traffic violation or equipment check?
questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: When stopped, you must show your driver's license, proof of registration, and proof of insurance. You are required to have all three documents in your vehicle.

questions.question: If you have had an argument and are angry, what should you do before driving?

options.text: Play loud music so you won't think about the argument.
Take a few minutes to calm down.
Drive on the interstate to release stress.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down.
questions.explanation: Your emotions affect how safely you drive. If you are angry, excited, afraid, worried, or sad, take time to relax before driving. You need to focus fully on driving without thinking about upsetting things.

questions.question: If a traffic light is green but a police officer signals you to stop, what should you do?

options.text: Do what the car in front of you does.

questions.correctAnswerText: Obey the officer.
questions.explanation: Always obey a police officer's signals, even if they conflict with traffic signs, signals, or laws.

questions.question: Which statement is correct?

options.text: Use cruise control near a railroad crossing to keep a steady speed.
You must stop at a railroad crossing when a flagger or stop sign tells you to.
You have the right-of-way at a railroad crossing and do not need to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must stop at a railroad crossing when a flagger or stop sign tells you to.
questions.explanation: Stop at a railroad crossing when a flagger, stop sign, or warning signal tells you to. Be careful when driving near railroad tracks.

questions.question: How should a seat belt be adjusted?

options.text: Snug across your hip bones and lower abdomen.
So the buzzer or light does not go off.

questions.correctAnswerText: Snug across your hip bones and lower abdomen.
questions.explanation: The lap belt should fit snugly across your hip bones and lower abdomen. The shoulder belt should be comfortable so you can fit your fist between the belt and your chest.

questions.question: Why is using a cell phone while driving a distraction?

options.text: It makes the driver worry about the call cost.
It takes the driver's hands, eyes, and attention off driving.
It catches the attention of other drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: It takes the driver's hands, eyes, and attention off driving.
questions.explanation: Cell phone use while driving is dangerous because it takes your eyes, hands, and mind off the road. Even skilled drivers increase their crash risk when using a cell phone.

questions.question: If traffic is blocking an intersection, what should you do?

options.text: Drive close to the car in front of you in case the light turns red.
Wait until you can completely cross the intersection before entering.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until you can completely cross the intersection before entering.
questions.explanation: Do not enter an intersection unless you can drive all the way across it. In heavy traffic, wait for vehicles ahead to clear the intersection before you move. This prevents you from blocking traffic when the light changes.

questions.question: Which statement is true about driving in bad weather?

options.text: Sudden weather changes mean you need to change how you drive.
Slow down when driving in rain and fog.
Watch for vehicles coming up behind you in bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: When weather changes suddenly, adjust your driving. Slow down in rain and fog. Be aware of vehicles behind you that may be going too fast for the conditions.

questions.question: When you see a school bus stopped with its stop arm out, what should you do?

options.text: Come to a complete stop and wait.
Honk and pass on the left side.
Keep driving when you think the kids have finished exiting.
Pass the bus before the door opens.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and wait.
questions.explanation: When a school bus stops with its stop arm out, you must come to a complete stop. Do not move until the stop arm is withdrawn.

questions.question: Before you start the engine, what should you do?

options.text: Make sure all passengers have buckled their safety belts.

questions.correctAnswerText: Both of the above.
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drive without a safety belt. Always fasten your belt and make sure your passengers do the same before you drive. Safety belts greatly reduce the chance of injury or death in a crash.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is closed to traffic.
The road ahead has construction or maintenance work.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead has construction or maintenance work.
questions.explanation: Construction and maintenance signs are orange and warn drivers of unusual or dangerous conditions in work areas. This sign tells you to slow down and drive carefully as you approach the construction zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Crossroad ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers of upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign alerts you that an intersection is coming.

questions.question: What do "No passing zone" signs tell drivers?

options.text: It is not safe to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: It is not safe to pass.
questions.explanation: A "No passing zone" sign means you cannot legally pass in that area. These zones exist where visibility is poor and passing would be unsafe.

questions.question: If pedestrians are illegally crossing in the middle of the street, what should you do?

options.text: You do not have to stop for them.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must stop for them.
questions.explanation: Always yield to pedestrians, even if they are crossing illegally or in the wrong place. You must stop for them no matter what.

questions.question: You want to turn right at a corner. A pedestrian with a guide dog is waiting to cross in front of you. What should you do?

options.text: Turn off your engine while the person crosses.
Tell the pedestrian when to cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until the person crosses.
questions.explanation: Pedestrians with guide dogs or white canes always have the right-of-way. You must let them cross before you drive.

questions.question: A school bus ahead on your side has red lights flashing. What must you do?

options.text: Slow down to 10 mph or less.
Stop until the lights stop flashing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop until the lights stop flashing.
questions.explanation: Flashing red lights mean the bus is loading or unloading students. You must stop and wait until the lights stop flashing. Never pass a school bus that is picking up or dropping off students.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be ready for traffic to merge into your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready for traffic to merge into your lane.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that traffic will be entering from the right. You should prepare to let them merge safely.

questions.question: What is important when driving on major highways?

options.text: Be ready to react to hazards.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Stay alert on highways and be ready for unexpected hazards. Keep your eyes moving to avoid highway hypnosis. Do not stare at one thing for more than a few seconds.

questions.question: If a car has airbags, should you wear your seat belt?

options.text: Yes, seat belts should still be worn.
No, seat belts are not needed.
Wear seat belts behind your back only.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yes, seat belts should still be worn.
questions.explanation: Airbags and seat belts work together to protect you. Always wear your seat belt, even if the car has airbags.
